decisions.reason: The passenger data transmission solution has proven government use and connections to over 30 APIS schemes, so it remains a core revenue source with high switching costs for customers.
The cyber security awareness module is cheap to maintain, complements the certified training business and addresses rising compliance demand such as NIS2.
Passenger security profiling is embedded in the firm's aviation security services, though regulatory and privacy scrutiny is a moderate risk.
The travel and document verification platform serves ongoing airline compliance needs and fits closely with the firm's established document and data offers.
